applicabilityBasis.summary: thUSD is marketed as a USD-pegged payment and transfer token, with yield confined to the separate sthUSD wrapper, supporting an apparent-payment-stablecoin watch classification. Direct redemption is disclosed only in USDC/USDT: GENIUS section 2(22)(A)(ii)(I) excludes a digital asset denominated in fixed monetary value from its monetary-value redemption test, so these disclosures alone do not establish definitive statutory inclusion.

genius.notes: Theo Protocol Corporation identifies a Panama registered address in its terms; no incorporation certificate or token-specific issuer agreement is linked. The terms expressly state that the company, platform and services are not registered or licensed by any governmental or regulatory authority. The OCC pending digital-assets licensing table and issuer sources reviewed on 2026-09-30 do not identify a Theo authorization or GENIUS pathway; this is a bounded public-source finding, not an exhaustive review of every federal or state register. The issuer pathway and foreign-exception posture remain unknown. The transparency dashboard displays Theo Protocol Corp and Libeara thBILL attestations and lists Accountable's auditor engagement as in progress, without linking a monthly aggregate independent reserve report. Additional custodian corroboration is described by Theo, not independently verified here. The apparent-payment-stablecoin label is an implementation-watch classification, not a definitive legal conclusion, given the stablecoin-only redemption disclosure.
